name: Lyle
source:
Lyle is a chronic overthinker who's always too hard on himself. He's having trouble adapting to the changes life has thrown his way, but with a little help he can learn to overcome his insecurities. He's sensitive, thoughtful, and suddenly has his hands full teaching five rambunctious dolls about the world!
